title: Fighting in Hanoi opens the First Indochina War
summary: Viet Minh forces attacked French positions in Hanoi, turning months of tension into open war. Ho Chi Minh and his government withdrew to the countryside.
reason: France sought to restore colonial rule in Indochina, while the Viet Minh had declared Vietnamese independence in 1945.
significance: It began the eight year war that ended French rule in Indochina.
